newsitem.title: USA: Applied Analytical to book $1mln in Q3 from suitor.
newsitem.headline: Applied Analytical to book $1mln in Q3 from suitor.

text.p: Applied Analytical Industries Inc said on Tuesday it received $1 million from a third party for a potential business combination which has since been terminated and will include that amount in its third quarter income.

Frederick Sancilio, chairman and chief executive officer, said the company had been engaged in discussions with a substantially larger third party concerning a potential business combination and at the request of the third party, the company suspended new licensing arrangements during the second quarter, which had an adverse effect on that quarter.

The company said the third party paid the $1 million in consideration for its loss of earnings associated with the suspension, the related disruption to normal business activities and related expenses.
Sancilio added that a portion of the income in the third quarter will be offset by related expenses and that the company did not recognize any of the payment in the second quarter.
In addition, the company said it intends to reinitiate new licensing activities in the third quarter.

Applied Analytical contracts research and development for the pharmaceutical and biotech industries, develops products, provides support services worldwide and licenses internally developed drugs and drug technologies to others.
